description: This file contains utility functions for building and modifying query objects and columns in a data visualization context, specifically for the Superset project. It includes functions for adding columns, filters, and tooltip information to query configurations.

methods.name: addJsColumnsToColumns
methods.description: Adds JavaScript-defined columns to an existing list of columns, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: addNullFilters
methods.description: Adds 'IS NOT NULL' filters for specified columns if they are not already present.

methods.name: addMetricNullFilter
methods.description: Adds null filter for a specific metric if provided.

methods.name: ensureColumnsUnique
methods.description: Removes duplicate columns from a list, ensuring all columns are unique.

methods.name: addColumnsIfNotExists
methods.description: Adds new columns to a base list if they do not already exist.

methods.name: extractTooltipColumns
methods.description: Extracts column names from tooltip content, which can be strings or objects.

methods.name: addTooltipColumnsToQuery
methods.description: Adds tooltip columns to a query configuration if they are not already included.
